You’ll need to defeat a NPC invader nearby to unlock it.

When you reach the Mausoleum Entrance head left up the stairs.
Follow that past the enemies to the top and enter the Mausoleum proper.
At the first intersection, a respawning NPC will appear. Left will take you to a merchant, right will take you to Mohg.

For defeating Mohg the Omen, you will receive Runes (75,000) and the Bloodflame Talons incantation - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide
After entering the arena, summon the Spirit Ashes to make the boss fight easier - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide
However, if you can't use Comet Azur, use the charged Magic Glintblade spell - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide

Mohg has several melee attacks that can reach you even if you keep a fair distance between you - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide

When the boss's health drops to around 50%, and you have three red circles around your character, he will start chanting the word Nihil three times - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide
In the second phase, Mohg will gain speed, and he will rise into the air using wings - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide
If you notice that the attack will leave a bloodflame spray, stay away from the boss - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide
Watch out mainly for the attack in which the boss rises into the air - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide

During the fight, you can notice a round seal on your character, which means that boss has inflicted a curse on you - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide
In addition, it can also "spray" fire that will hurt your character and build up bleeding - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide

However, if you are not lucky, the boss will curse you and this dangerous attack can deal you damage 3 times - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide

The second stage of the fight is particularly demanding - the opponent sprays a lot of fire all over the arena - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide

The enemy often rises into the air, spreads bloodflame in front of him, and then lands with a powerful weapon swing - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide
Also, watch out for the enemy's charge - it's quite easy to avoid it by dodging to the side - Elden Ring: How to beat Mohg, Lord of Blood? - Elden Ring: All bosses in Siofra River - Elden Ring Guide
